progression.label: Research foundations
progression.title: Start with the question and the data.
progression.body: NASA DEVELOP and WWF work connected data acquisition, harmonization and spatial analysis with research on water, air quality and land-use change.

progression.label: Models & data systems
progression.title: Make the analysis reproducible.
progression.body: University and energy research expanded the work into data harmonization, predictive modeling, model interpretation and pipelines for large spatial datasets.

progression.label: Independent software
progression.title: Put the methods into people's hands.
progression.body: As PredioAI's creator and sole developer, I connect that analytical background with product design, REST APIs, document geometry, interactive mapping and deployment.

publications.title: United States multi-sector land use and land cover base maps to support human and Earth system models
publications.description: A harmonized U.S. land-use and land-cover dataset connecting multiple classification systems and Earth system modeling needs. The case study explains my data-processing contribution and the published figures.

publications.title: Reconstructing Long-Term Historical Hydrologic Alteration to Support Environmental Flows in Texas
publications.description: Coauthored research on reference hydrology and hydrologic alteration. My case study describes watershed processing and reference-stream classification, and separates those contributions from the team's paper-wide results.
